rows.name: Document Submission
rows.description: The applicant uploads a scanned or photographed copy of a physical document. Satisfied when the document is accepted by a GlobeIQ coordinator.

rows.name: Appointment Completion
rows.description: The applicant attends a scheduled appointment at an authority office (police station, tax office, etc.). Satisfied when the appointment record is confirmed complete.

rows.name: Authority Confirmation
rows.description: The authority issues a formal confirmation letter or digital record. Satisfied when the confirmation document is received and uploaded.

rows.name: Online Form Submission
rows.description: The applicant completes and submits an online form through an authority portal. Satisfied when a submission reference number is recorded.

rows.name: Payment Receipt
rows.description: Proof that a required fee has been paid (visa fee, registration fee, etc.). Satisfied when a payment receipt is uploaded.

rows.name: Biometric Capture
rows.description: The applicant attends an appointment for fingerprints, photo, or other biometric data collection. Satisfied when the authority confirms capture is complete.
